tasks.name: invoice-review-security
tasks.result:
## Aspect: security
- [IMPORTANT] src/cli.js:13 — Unbounded stdin is accumulated in memory before parsing, so a caller that supplies excessively large input can exhaust the CLI process’s memory. Evidence: the `for await` loop reads every chunk and line 14 appends each chunk to `document` without a size limit; `JSON.parse` then processes the accumulated string. Fix: enforce a maximum input size while reading and reject oversized input before parsing. Confidence: 88.

tasks.name: invoice-review-architecture
tasks.result:
## Aspect: architecture
- [IMPORTANT] package.json:10 — The package ships only `dist`, but its scripts define a manual `build` and no packaging hook to refresh that directory. If `src` changes and someone runs `npm pack` without first rebuilding, the tarball can contain stale or missing entry points. Confidence: 86. Evidence: `package.json` lists only `dist` under `files` (lines 10–12) and defines `build` separately (lines 13–17); `scripts/build.mjs` copies `src` into `dist`. Fix: add a `prepack` script that runs the build so packaged artifacts are generated from the current source.

tasks.name: invoice-review-tests
tasks.result:
## Aspect: tests
- [IMPORTANT] tests/cli.test.js:6 — The CLI tests execute `src/cli.js` directly, so they do not verify the package’s published `invoice-quote` entry point or that the built distribution includes a working CLI. A broken `bin` mapping or packaging change could pass these tests. Confidence: 91. Evidence: `tests/cli.test.js` resolves `../src/cli.js` and passes that path to `spawnSync`; `package.json` maps `invoice-quote` to `./dist/cli.js`. Fix: add a reproducible package smoke test that builds and packs the package, installs it in a temporary consumer, and invokes the installed `invoice-quote` executable.

tasks.name: invoice-review-judge-second
tasks.result:
## Aspect: judge (second run)
- [IMPORTANT] JUDGE-B1 src/cli.js:16 — `JSON.parse` can round a fractional JSON number to an integer before validation, so the CLI may accept an invalid price or quantity and compute a quote from the rounded value. For example, a value such as `1.0000000000000001` can parse as `1`, which passes the integer checks in `src/index.js`; this conflicts with the integer-input contract documented in `README.md`. Confidence: 84. Evidence: `src/cli.js` parses the document with `JSON.parse`, then passes its numeric fields to `quoteInvoice`; `src/index.js` validates only the resulting JavaScript numbers, and `tests/cli.test.js` covers ordinary fractions but not values rounded to integers during parsing. Fix: validate numeric tokens without losing their exact decimal form, or use an input representation that preserves exact integer validation before calling `quoteInvoice`.

## Summary

## Main-Thread Evidence
- Tests: `npm test` and `npm run lint` exited 0; the `invoice-quote` checkpoint passed; acceptance exited 0 with 4/4 active criteria passing.
- Build: `npm run build` exited successfully. The packed tarball was installed offline into a disposable consumer; its API and invoice-quote bin were exercised successfully.
- Coverage: `npm run coverage` passed. Node reported `src/cli.js` and `src/index.js` at 100.00% lines, 100.00% branches, and 100.00% functions, exceeding all configured 90% thresholds.

## Critical Issues
None.

## Important Issues
- **[IMPORTANT] R1-F1 — `package.json:10`** — npm pack can publish stale or missing dist files when callers do not run the build first. Evidence: the package ships only dist and has a separate build script without a prepack hook. Fix: build automatically during pack. [VERIFIED]
- **[IMPORTANT] R1-F2 — `src/cli.js:13-14`** — stdin is accumulated without a size limit before JSON parsing, permitting excessive memory use. Evidence: every stream chunk is appended to document. Fix: reject input beyond a documented finite limit. [VERIFIED]
- **[IMPORTANT] R1-F4 — `src/cli.js:16`** — JSON.parse can round a fractional numeric token to a safe integer before quoteInvoice validates it, so 1.0000000000000001 may be accepted as 1. Evidence: the parsed number is passed to quoteInvoice without retaining its token. Fix: preserve and validate the exact numeric token before passing it to quoteInvoice. [VERIFIED]
- **[IMPORTANT] R1-F3 — `tests/cli.test.js:6`** — CLI tests invoke src/cli.js directly and do not test the built package bin mapping. Evidence: cliPath resolves ../src/cli.js. Fix: add a package smoke test that packs, installs offline into a disposable consumer, and runs the installed bin. [VERIFIED]

## Suggestions
None.
